datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data were compiled into spatial datasets representing food insecurity phases across administrative areas in Sierra Leone for February and June 2016.
